==========================================================================
  STEP 5  what an attacker needs to know
==========================================================================
  username source  : employee uid in the corporate directory
                    (often the corporate email local-part)
  password formula : username + "MaxKey@888"
  LDAP knowledge   : NOT required -- the account is mirrored locally,
                    so the attacker never touches the LDAP server.
  LDAP creds       : NOT required -- MaxKey already synced the row.
  outcome          : full local login as the synced employee, with
                    MaxKey's own ROLE_USER / app grants.
